name: Shinjou Ruri
source:
Shinjo and Aoi's little sister who was one of the victims of the missing persons cases known as The Akiba Vanishing.
Thirteen years ago at the age of nine, she disappeared at a game arcade in Akihabara when Shinjo took his eyes off her for a moment. Her whereabouts and fate have remained unknown.
Although a little spoiled, she was an innocent and cheerful girl who loved to play with Shinjo and Aoi. She liked video games and, most of all, was very fond of playing Magical Schoolgirl Lilica.

[From in-game profile]
